elements.description:
Sets the default look for every Trenchcoat element inside it. Renders nothing of its own (display: contents).
  <tc-look-provider look="clean"> … </tc-look-provider>

properties.name: look
properties.description: The look every Trenchcoat element inside takes unless it sets its own: "standard" or "clean"

functions.name: lookContext
functions.description: The app-wide default look, set with <tc-look-provider look="clean"> (decision L6); an element's own `look` wins

changelog: Lit 3 web components: `tc-button`, `tc-combobox` and `tc-data-table` (the pilot), `tc-look-provider` for an app-wide default look, the shared controllers (row window, focus rescue, smooth height, off-screen, on-screen, ARIA forwarding, hotkeys, rolling numbers). Pixel-identical to the React components in both looks and themes.
